items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Yeah, I worked with Paul Barnes. He worked with Jitney Dance.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you, did you ever work with Earl Barnes?
Not Earl Barnes, Paul Barnes. Oh, Paul Barnes. Yeah, I worked with Paul Barnes. He worked with Jitney Dance. Mm-hmm.
Is that before the Gypsy Tea Room or after?
